cycleStart: <sha of main when the cycle started>
scratch: /abs/path/to/a DURABLE dir, not the session scratchpad (sandboxes live in <scratch>/<sandboxDir>/<ID>, plus wt-<ID> symlinks and fixer scratch); e.g. the tooling folder, which is gitignored and outside any sync

prod.rule: APP_SERVER may point at production (in the global environment, or in a shell outside the agent session; a project settings file may override it for the session) — always pass `--server http://localhost:<port>` to every CLI call that talks to a server, never rely on the default.

signin: command that signs a test user in, or omit
gateSummary: regex of the gate-output lines merge.sh echoes after a pass, e.g. ^ℹ (pass|fail) for node:test; omit to echo nothing
sandboxCopy: gitignored/cache/dir the app needs at run time
fixerRun: how to serve from a worktree (e.g. the dot-directory symlink trick), how to link dependencies, where Vite/dev caches go
